text:
Maya: Heads up — customer reported a mismatch: console shows 'Quota policy threshold: 80%' but the Python SDK calls are getting enforced at 90% and we see 429s. cc @Liam @Samir
Liam: Which customer/tenant?
Maya: acme-inc (sandbox). Steps: bulk-embed via py sdk, console shows warning at 80% but calls start failing sooner. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/abc123
Samir: We rolled a small API rename in v2 — console reads `policyThreshold` from body, SDKs are still sending legacy header `X-Policy-Limit`. Gateway currently prefers body and falls back to tenant default (90) when header is unknown.
Alex: Repro'd locally. Py SDK sends `X-Policy-Limit: 80` here: ```python
headers = {'X-Policy-Limit': '80'}
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
``` Server ignores it and uses default.
Jen: Wasn't there a gateway mapping that translated legacy headers to the new body field?
Samir: There was, but we disabled it for perf in mid-Jan. We need to decide: re-enable translation in gateway, or patch all SDKs to send canonical `policyThreshold` in the request body.
Maya: :thinking_face: Customers will be confused if console and SDK semantics differ. What's the least disruptive path?
Frank: For SDKs we can add a compatibility flag `REDWOOD_LEGACY_POLICY_SHIM=true` to preserve old behavior for a short window and log warnings.
Liam: I prefer a server-side shim for minimal churn, but perf concerns matter. @deploy-bot do we have telemetry on CPU impact if we enable translation?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Last 7d avg CPU on policy-proxy: 62%. Canary with translation on shows ~3% p95 CPU increase.
Jen: 3% seems acceptable if we gate it by-tenant. Also console should display the canonical field name and show the legacy alias in the tooltip so customers understand.
Alex: I'll open a py-sdk PR to emit the canonical field and add a runtime warning when the legacy header is present.
Maya: Proposed plan: (1) Re-enable translation behind feature-flag for affected tenants; (2) Patch Python + TS SDKs to send `policyThreshold` in body and log deprecation warnings; (3) Console UI shows both names + tooltip; (4) 30-day deprecation window and customer notice.
Samir: Agree. Also add telemetry metric `policy.header.mismatch` to track tenants hitting the fallback path.
Liam: Can we test quickly in staging? Alex, can you enable shim only for acme-inc in staging so we stop their 429s?
Alex: On it — will push a staging change and ping here once the canary is green.
Maya: Also adding a short TS snippet for docs: ```ts
await client.post('/embed', { data, policyThreshold: 80 })
```
Frank: :thumbsup: I'll draft customer-facing deprecation email and coordinate support.
Jen: Note for ops: add alert `policy.header.mismatch > 5/min` to detect spike during migration.
Maya: Drafted an ops playbook in Confluence (internal): https://confluence.internal/redwood/policy-shim-migration (draft)
Liam: Great — looping in Product for console copy: @Olivia
Olivia: On it — will update tooltip copy and schedule change in the next console deploy.
